description: Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Department - Niotifying that the Report of Supplementary Environmental Impact Assesment study on proposed Colombo Port City Development Project will be available for public inspection from 01.12.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the public inspection and comment period for a Supplementary Environmental Impact Assessment Report, which is a regulatory requirement under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act. It deals with legal/regulatory compliance procedures for a development project, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for matters involving regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements.
